title: Perennial
summary: A Rocq and Iris framework for verifying concurrent, crash-safe systems, including recovery procedures, with Goose as a source language and Grove for distributed-system reasoning.

source.statement: Perennial verifies correctness of systems with concurrency and crash-safety requirements, including recovery procedures.

license.attribution: Tej Chajed; repository owner and pinned commit author

reuse: Clone the full repository, initialize recursive submodules, install a supported Rocq release, and run make. For the selected lock developments, the relevant source files are src/goose_lang/lib/lock/lock.v and src/goose_lang/lib/lock/crash_lock.v; they depend on the surrounding Perennial, Iris, stdpp and Goose modules.

contents: Concurrent and crash-safe program logic; Goose language and proofs; Grove distributed-system verification; verified example systems.
project_details.setup: Install Rocq, initialize submodules with git submodule update --init --recursive, then run make from the repository root. The README describes development against Rocq master and compatibility with the latest Rocq. The captured tree does not retain complete dependency pins.
